description: Scan text for PII (Personally Identifiable Information) and optionally redact it. Supports regional PII profiles (v1.1) for country-specific and industry-specific detection across 13 countries and 3 industries. Returns found PII types and redacted text.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent making the call, if known. Recorded on the receipt when the cloud API is used; left out entirely otherwise rather than guessed.

industry.description: Industry profile to activate for specialized PII patterns

redact.description: Whether to return redacted text (default: true)

region.description: Regional PII profiles to activate (e.g. ['ae', 'in']). Available: au, us, gb, eu, ae, sa, ng, in, jp, cn, kr, br

session_id.description: Session ID for correlating calls, if known.

text.description: The text to scan for PII

name: tork_scan_pii
